blocks.text: We will run the advisory schedule today. A reminder to all Juniors and Seniors to report to Fuller Hall during advisory for ALICE training. 9th and 10th graders should report to their advisory locations.
Tomorrow we will have our first Pep Chapel of the year! All students and advisors should report directly to the Alumni Gym by 7:55am. Get ready to get that Topper beat!
Seniors: rise, shine, and get your glow on tomorrow morning at Senior Sunrise at 5:30am! Kick off senior year with the best view and the best crew. Check your email for more details.
Reminder — the 2027 India trip has a meeting in Tinker house after school.

Academy theater is holding a Tech crew meeting for this falls production of “She Kills Monsters” today @ 4pm in the stage craft shop in Morse. So, if you’re interested in building sets, making props, and designing puppets, come to the stage craft room in Morse today at 4pm to find out more. Please email Mr. Kane with any questions.

The Zen Zone meets after school today — and every Thursday — in NH 10 starting at 3:30. Come find your inner calm! This club is open to everyone. Come if you want to relax and learn how to clear your mind of clutter. See Ms. Greenstone with questions.
Chess Club meets today at 3:15 in Streeter 225. Master to novice, all are welcome! That’s chess club, every Thursday at 3:15 in Streeter 225. Any questions, see Mr. Buhner, also in Streeter 225.

In support of our first responders, our home opener football game on Friday night will be themed red, white, and blue! Dress your best to appreciate our emergency service providers and support our football team.
Now it’s time for Michael’s Joke of the Week: What do you call a boomerang that never comes back?…A stick 😊

Happy Birthday today to Sophie White! Happy Birthday tomorrow to Alexander Evans, Enyu Hu, Brady MacQueen, Hannah Santy, Kenyon Sorrell, and Claire Trojano, on Sunday to Lilias Robillard and Fernanda Torres Molina Pinho, and on Monday to Easton Kissinger and Carlie Rondeau!
